programs.title: Late Night With Seth Meyers
programs.desc: Emmy Award-nominated “Late Night with Seth Meyers,” hosted by award-winning writer and performer Seth Meyers, is home to incisive humor, topical jokes and A-list celebrity guests. The series' signature “A Closer Look” segment has garnered millions of views and is widely lauded for its tightly written and thoughtful approach to analyzing and satirizing news of the day.

programs.title: Channel Japan
programs.desc: 'Channel Japan' offers a fresh look at the latest in the economy, business, technology, culture and sightseeing of Japan.

programs.title: Leaders Playbook
programs.desc: Through candid, in-depth interviews with America's top CEOs, CNBC's Senior Media & Tech Correspondent Julia Boorstin explores the leadership philosophies, strategic decisions and personal decisions that have shaped today's most influential companies.

programs.title: Converge
programs.desc: CNBC delivers 24-hour live business intelligence, financial market tracking, and macroeconomic analysis focusing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, mainland Chinese market spillover, and pan-Asian trade regulatory updates.

programs.title: CNBC Explains
programs.desc: ‘CNBC Explains' is a dynamic explainer series that dives deep into the forces shaping our world. Each episode unpacks complex business and economic topics, breaking them down into clear, compelling narratives. With expert insights, data-driven visuals and a global perspective, this series helps viewers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters.

programs.title: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
programs.desc: Emmy Award- and Grammy Award-winning comedian Jimmy Fallon brings a high-tempo energy to the storied NBC franchise with his welcoming interview style, love of audience participation, spot-on impersonations and innovative sketches.
